lines: Hard Rock (Florida) prices: player rebounds, points, assists and 3-pointers made, the main line, over or under. No leg worse than -200.

The rule: Pinnacle moves its price on a line by 2+ points of chance between two checks, and Hard Rock's price is at or better than Pinnacle's fair price (their chance with the margin stripped). We bet the side Pinnacle moved toward.
Prices are checked at 11 AM and roughly 90, 45 and 20 minutes before tip. The pick freezes at the first check that qualifies; that price is what gets graded.
Proven on the Record from Oct 28; judged at 150 bets.
A player listed Out or Doubtful is never picked. Questionable or game-time decision waits until he is cleared or confirmed starting. Needs 10+ games of history.
Early = injury news still open. Injury report clear = he and his team's main rotation are cleared. Starters confirmed = both teams' starting fives are posted.

A pick is pulled if he is ruled out or doubtful, or Hard Rock takes the line down. If Hard Rock moves the line after a pick posts, it shows TOO LATE — if you already have it at the shown price, keep it. It still counts on the Record.
One pick per player per market a night. No cap per game or per night. No parlays.
Graded after the game at the shown price, 1 unit flat. Overtime counts. Did not play = void.
Lab tab (not the Record): Pinnacle as judge, Hard Rock 2%+ better than fair price on the same line.
New picks stop by themselves if the Record falls to -10 units.
